body.citation: William Torous, Florian Gunsilius, and Philippe Rigollet. An optimal transport approach to estimating causal effects via nonlinear difference-in-differences. Journal of Causal Inference 12(1), article 20230004, 1--26, 2024. doi:10.1515/jci-2023-0004. See Section 3.1, Definition 1 and equation (6), the paragraph immediately following Definition 1, and Theorem 2 for cyclical comonotonicity, the composition \(h_1\circ h_0^{-1}\), and counterfactual-law identification; the same subsection states that compositions of optimal-transport maps are generally not optimal transports except in special circumstances.
